selection_basis: static.yml is fully pinned to full-length Action commit SHAs
static.yml has observed scoped successful Pages execution on the predecessor cut
mdbook.yml, nextjs.yml and jekyll-gh-pages.yml self-identify as sample workflows
the predecessor cut demonstrated policy rejection of tag-pinned Actions for automatic execution
one automatic producer removes cross-workflow concurrency ambiguity on the same Pages environment

.github/workflows/jekyll-gh-pages.yml.known_gap: tag-pinned Actions are incompatible with the observed full-SHA policy until explicitly hardened

.github/workflows/nextjs.yml.known_gap: tag-pinned Actions are incompatible with the observed full-SHA policy until explicitly hardened

invariants: Exactly one Pages workflow MAY auto-trigger from push(main)
The automatic producer MUST use full-length Action commit SHA pins
Alternative producers MUST remain manual-only until this contract is explicitly superseded
supersession_rule: Any change of automatic producer requires an explicit successor of this contract, evidence for the replacement workflow, and a rollback path.
rollback: Revert the authority-binding commit; preserved manual workflows retain their previous content except trigger scope.
residual_token_vazio: long-term product intent for mdBook/Next.js/Jekyll alternatives
